title: mint-key.mjs ALL_SCOPES now includes send-now, so every key it mints (live-verify) can launch a bot into a meeting
evidence: scripts/mint-key.mjs ALL_SCOPES gained "send-now" as instructed (Approver ruling 2026-10-12: minting must be possible). That list is the only scope set the script mints, and join-rules was never in it, so this is the first write scope that lands on the verification key.
reproduction: node scripts/mint-key.mjs  (needs Mongo; not run) -> the printed key holds send-now; POST /calendar/send-now on a host wired with createSendNowDeps would launch a recorder.
fix_direction: Give mint-key a --scopes flag defaulting to the read scopes, and mint send-now only on request.

title: The API's own recent-launch memory is per process and 10 minutes long
evidence: apps/api/src/join-rules/send-now.ts keeps a Map of launches it made (RECENT_LAUNCH_MS). It is lost on restart, is not shared by two API processes, and does not see manual or poller launches (ISS-T039CMD-001/-002 remain open).
reproduction: POST, restart the host, POST again with the scheduler stores empty: second launch is accepted.
fix_direction: Real fix is the shared state write named in ISS-T039CMD-001/-002.

title: 202 means the launcher process survived 2 s, not that the bot joined; there is no status endpoint and the 60 s join clause is unmeasured
evidence: scripts/webinar/send-now-host.ts launch(): spawn detached, watch for error/exit for livenessMs (2000), then resolve. A recorder that fails later (profile lock, join refused) is visible only in raw/webinars/<jobId>.log.
reproduction: Start a launch whose CLI exits after 5 s: API has already answered 202.
fix_direction: A GET job-status route fed by the same state write as ISS-T039CMD-001/-002; a live measurement of join latency.

title: Production wiring exists only in scripts/webinar/join-rules-api-host.ts; apps/api/src/index.ts and buildProductionDeps leave send-now answering 503
evidence: apps/* may not import packages/meeting-bot, so server.ts and composition/production.ts could not carry the real adapter. server.ts is untouched by design (the dep rides on CalendarReadDeps).
reproduction: Start the API through index.ts and POST /calendar/send-now with a send-now key: 503 send_now_unavailable.
fix_direction: Decide the one supported API host.

title: `until` is only syntax-checked: a far-future ISO (2099) or a past one is accepted by plan(); no upper or lower bound
evidence: createSendNowDeps().plan with the real todayAt: until=2099-01-01T00:00:00Z -> ok; 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z -> ok (child then dies within 2 s, API answers 502 after having spawned a process); 99:99 and 25:00 -> ok (setHours rolls over to the next day).
fix_direction: In plan(): refuse until <= now and until > now + a cap (e.g. 12 h) with 400 invalid-until; reject HH:MM with hour>23 or minute>59.
